headline: Korea's Composure Wins After Wayward First Half
story: Korea Republic dictated possession (56 per cent) and territory throughout, but early profligacy nearly cost them dearly. They spurned three gilt-edged chances before the break—a blocked effort (45+2) and two saved attempts at 49 and 56 minutes—allowing Czechia to steal ahead at 59 with a low-expectation finish. The shape remained unchanged: Korea pressing but struggling to convert, Czechia compact and opportunistic.

Korea's dominance in ball recovery (12.8 seconds to Czechia's 18.4) proved decisive. After trailing, they converted twice in 13 minutes—first through a 0.31 xG chance at 67, then a cleaner 0.37 opportunity at 80. In-beom Hwang (8.9 rating) and Lee Kang-in (8.0) drove the second-half onslaught, while Czechia's Ladislav Krejčí (7.2) couldn't sufficiently shield a flagging rearguard. Korea's clinical finish, not their territorial dominance, won the day.

keyMoment.text: Korea equalizes with a 0.31 xG chance; from this moment, their ball recovery dominance becomes irresistible.

home.verdict: Second-half composure salvaged a first-half misfiring attack; defending lapse nearly proved fatal.
points: Ball recovery speed (12.8s vs 18.4s) was the platform: faster transitions unlocked two finishing chances.
Hwang's 8.9 rating and Kang-in's 8.0 were decisive; Czechia's defensive average offered no answer.
Missed three big chances (45+2, 49, 56) before Czechia's goal; that nearly proved fatal but composure held.

away.verdict: Early proficiency might have held; Korea's xG advantage (1.77 vs 0.64) proved insurmountable.
points: Krejčí's 22' miss (0.28 xG) needed to go in; one goal then alters the entire trajectory.
Conceding twice in 13 minutes (67-80) was fatal; sharpness at 59 came too late.
Ball recovery lag (18.4s vs 12.8s) meant transitions favoured Korea; defensive shape fractured under pressure.

statLine: Having wasted three first-half chances, Korea Republic then converted twice in 13 minutes to transform a potential upset into a routine victory.
